Binding for this project on top of the corpus renderings (../renderings.md, §0–§6). Translators add rows here at the first occurrence of each recurring term.

Lemmas: ETCSL's TEI lemmas (ORACC has no text of 5.3.5). "Lines" = ETCSL labels. Hebrew as in the > lines (plene; niqqud where the line has it).
